title: Short- and Long-Term Effects of Universal Preschool: Evidence from the Arab Population in Israel
title_zh: 以色列阿拉伯人口中普及学前教育的短期与长期效应
authors: Elad DeMalach, Analia Schlosser
abstract: We estimate the causal impacts of universal preschool by leveraging a quasi-experimental design based on Israel’s implementation of free public preschool for children ages 3 and 4 beginning in September 1999. We focus on the Arab population, who were the main beneficiaries of the first phase of the law’s implementation. Using a difference-in-differences (DID) research design, we find that universal preschool enhanced individuals’ academic performance from elementary school through high school, improved the learning environment, and increased postsecondary enrollment. Additional benefits include reduced juvenile delinquency among males and decreased early marriage among females. (JEL I21, I24, I28, J15, J16)
abstract_zh: 我们利用以色列自1999年9月起对3至4岁儿童实施免费公立学前教育的准实验设计，评估了普及型学前教育的因果影响。研究聚焦于该法律第一阶段的主要受益群体——阿拉伯人口。通过双重差分（DID）研究设计，我们发现普及型学前教育提升了个人从小学到高中的学业表现，改善了学习环境，并提高了高等教育入学率。其他益处包括降低男性青少年犯罪率和减少女性早婚现象。（JEL I21, I24, I28, J15, J16）

title: From field trials to farm adoption: identifying the productivity effect of on-farm technology adoption
title_zh: 从田间试验到农场采纳：识别农场技术采纳的生产率效应
authors: Kristiina Ala-Kokko, Jesse B. Tack, Jisang Yu
abstract: Technology adoption is an important farm management decision and is frequently made using information that is unavailable to the researcher. Aside from their own experiences, producers often rely on extension services to inform their adoption decisions. Here, we propose a novel instrumental variable (IV) approach to identify the effect that a new technology, genetically modified (GM) corn, has on farm yield using instruments constructed from extension information. The proposed approach allows us to explore the degree to which endogeneity bias is present in the GM adoption effect on farm productivity. Candidate instruments are constructed from variety trial data to resemble information acquired by producers from university extension variety trial reports and are spatially merged with on-farm production data. We find that failure to account for the endogeneity of the adoption decision does indeed result in an upward bias in the estimated productivity gains. After correcting for this bias through our IV approach, GM corn results in large on-farm yield gains of 19.6 bushels per acre. We demonstrate that variety trial data can be used to estimate the on-farm impact of new technology, and this approach is general enough to be applied to additional contexts (i.e., technologies, crops, and/or locations).
abstract_zh: 技术采纳是农场管理中的一项重要决策，且通常基于研究者无法获取的信息进行。除自身经验外，生产者常依赖推广服务来指导其采纳决策。本文提出一种新的工具变量（IV）方法，利用推广信息构建的工具变量，识别转基因玉米这一新技术对农场产量的影响。该方法使我们能够探究转基因采纳效应中内生性偏差对农场生产率影响的程度。候选工具变量基于品种试验数据构建，以模拟生产者从大学推广品种试验报告中获取的信息，并与农场生产数据进行空间匹配。研究发现，若未考虑采纳决策的内生性，确实会导致估计的生产率提升出现向上偏差。通过IV方法纠正这一偏差后，转基因玉米使农场产量实现每英亩19.6蒲式耳的大幅提升。我们证明，品种试验数据可用于估算新技术对农场的影响，且该方法具有足够普适性，可应用于其他情境（如不同技术、作物或地区）。

title: Housing Supply Elasticities: A Structural Vector Autoregression Approach
title_zh: 住房供给弹性：结构向量自回归方法
authors: Wesley A. Miller, Anthony W. Orlando, Christian L. Redfearn
abstract: We estimate the first time‐varying, county‐level index of housing supply elasticities across the United States, using a structural vector autoregression model with sign restrictions to identify the effect of a positive demand shock. This index reveals four features of the supply curve in different local housing markets. First, supply elasticities are low, on average, generating faster price growth than housing unit growth for most of the country. Second, there is significant variation in elasticities across counties, both urban and rural. Third, elasticities have declined in more counties than they have risen over time, particularly in large urban markets. Fourth, these new estimates predict housing quantity growth better than previous models in the literature.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们利用带有符号约束的结构向量自回归模型识别正向需求冲击效应，首次估算了美国各县级住房供给弹性的时变指数。该指数揭示了不同地方住房市场供给曲线的四个特征：第一，平均而言供给弹性较低，导致全国大部分地区房价增速快于住房单元增速；第二，城乡各县之间的弹性存在显著差异；第三，随时间推移，弹性下降的县数量多于上升的县，尤其是在大型城市市场；第四，相较于文献中的既有模型，这些新估计值能更准确地预测住房数量增长。

title: Paths to the Rainforests: Ancestral Beliefs and Fertility in Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 通往雨林之路：撒哈拉以南非洲的祖先信仰与生育率
authors: Alvarez-Aragon, Pablo
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Conventional demographic models systematically overestimate fertility decline in sub-Saharan Africa. This paper proposes a complementary explanation grounded in a prevalent but understudied belief system: ancestors influence the living and seek the continuation of their lineage, into which they may be reincarnated. In this worldview, having children becomes a moral and collective duty, rooted in the spiritual responsibility to ensure the survival of the lineage. Drawing on first-hand data, novel ethnographic information, and historical and contemporary surveys, I document a strong and quantitatively large positive relationship between ancestral beliefs and fertility across contexts and time periods. A simple model in which children are a public good for the lineage rationalizes the patterns observed in the data: the fertility effect of ancestral beliefs is concentrated in patrilineal societies, and a specific form of free-riding emerges among siblings whose children continue the same family line. These findings suggest that high fertility in sub-Saharan Africa rests on moral foundations that standard, externally designed interventions tend to overlook.
abstract_zh: 传统人口模型系统性地高估了撒哈拉以南非洲地区的生育率下降趋势。本文提出一种基于普遍存在但研究不足的信仰体系的补充解释：祖先影响生者，并寻求其血脉延续，生者可能转世为后代。在这种世界观中，生育子女成为一项道德与集体义务，根植于确保血脉存续的精神责任。通过利用一手数据、新颖的民族志信息以及历史与当代调查，本文记录了祖先信仰与生育率之间在不同情境与时间跨度中呈现的强烈且数量显著的正向关联。一个将子女视为血脉公共品的简单模型，合理化了数据中观察到的模式：祖先信仰对生育率的影响集中于父系社会，且兄弟姐妹间因子女延续同一家族血脉而出现特定形式的搭便车行为。这些发现表明，撒哈拉以南非洲的高生育率建立在道德基础之上，而标准的外部干预措施往往忽视这一基础。

title: New U.S. Business Establishments: Surging or Stalling?

authors: Dan Cao, Henry Hyatt, Toshihiko Mukoyama, Erick Sager
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Since the 1990s, the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) has reported much more rapid growth in U.S. private sector employer establishments than has the Census Bureau – the gap reached roughly 1.6 million by 2023. Using linked BLS-Census microdata, we document two main drivers. First, a large and growing number of employers providing services to the elderly and persons with disabilities are in scope for the BLS frame but not the Census Bureau’s. Second, many firms appear with substantially more establishments in the BLS frame. These discrepancies substantially affect the measured establishment size distribution and quantitative policy analysis.
abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，美国劳工统计局（BLS）报告的私营部门雇主机构数量增速远超人口普查局——截至2023年，两者差距已达约160万家。通过关联BLS与人口普查局的微观数据，我们揭示了两大驱动因素：其一，为老年人和残障人士提供服务的雇主机构中，有大量且持续增长的机构属于BLS统计框架范围，但未被纳入人口普查局框架；其二，许多企业在BLS框架中显示的机构数量显著更多。这些差异对测度的机构规模分布及量化政策分析产生了实质性影响。

title: Equilibrium with Internal Transfers
title_zh: 主要发达国家科技领域监管创新战略分析研究
authors: Liu, Mingyang, Farina, Gabriele, Ozdaglar, Asuman
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Nash equilibrium (NE) arises from selfish utility maximization, yet its social welfare can be arbitrarily far from optimal. Moreover, computing an NE is intractable in general. We study augmented game models in which players use budget-balanced internal transfers to improve incentives before play. We first introduce \emph{Self-Enforcing Transfer Equilibrium} (SETE), where players commit to nonnegative peer-to-peer transfers that are paid only if the recipient does not deviate from a prescribed strategy. For polymatrix games, we show that every stationary point of the social welfare function, in particular any socially optimal strategy profile, can be sustained as a SETE. This induces a Nash equilibrium in the agent normal form of the corresponding augmented game. We further propose a polynomial-time algorithm and a decentralized learning dynamic to compute such product-form equilibria. We then introduce \emph{Mediated Self-Enforcing Transfer Equilibrium} (M-SETE), where a mediator makes both the payment schedule and the prescribed strategies binding offers. This additional enforcement resolves the agent-normal-form limitation: an M-SETE is a Nash equilibrium of the augmented game itself, not merely of its agent normal form, and any socially optimal strategy profile can be supported as an M-SETE in any finite game while preserving budget balance. Thus, internal transfers improve welfare and computation while preserving independent play on the equilibrium path. When full sequential-game stability is required, binding mediation provides the corresponding implementation.
abstract_zh: 国际投资者如何根据生物多样性风险调整投资组合？利用投资基金的月度组合数据，我们发现2021年《昆明宣言》促使基金经理将投资组合从高生物多样性风险国家重新配置至风险较低的国家，而最终基金投资者对此并未作出反应。基金经理减少了极端高生物多样性风险的敞口，但并未将低生物多样性风险视为盈利机会，从而将生物多样性定性为下行风险因素。投资基金会引发跨国溢出效应，因为这种重新配置触发了显著的资本流动，使同一地理区域内但基金所在国以外的国家受益。

title: From Meat to Plant‐Based Products? The Enduring Impact of BSE on Beef Consumption
title_zh: 从肉类到植物基产品？疯牛病对牛肉消费的持久影响
authors: Jader Velásquez, Shon Ferguson
abstract: This study reassesses the impact of the historical BSE outbreak on EU diets, showing that consumption patterns shifted persistently even after policy actions eliminated the food safety risk. Utilizing advanced difference‐in‐differences techniques on 1980–2020 data, we demonstrate that while beef consumption exhibited a transient U‐shaped recovery relative to other meats, it declined sharply compared to plant‐based products, with average reductions of 79%, 29%, and 28% for pulses, cereals, and vegetable oils, respectively. This highlights a structural dietary change, overlooked by previous analyses focused on meat substitution. Results are robust to sensitivity analyses. Understanding the primary drivers behind the structural shift in EU consumer diets over recent decades is crucial for future research investigating the reduction in red meat consumption driven by environmental and health concerns in high‐income countries.
abstract_zh: 本研究重新评估了历史上疯牛病疫情对欧盟饮食结构的影响，结果表明即使在政策行动消除食品安全风险后，消费模式仍发生了持续性转变。基于1980-2020年数据，采用先进的双重差分技术，我们发现：牛肉消费相对于其他肉类呈现短暂的U型恢复，但相较于植物性产品则显著下降——豆类、谷物和植物油的消费量平均分别减少79%、29%和28%。这揭示了以往聚焦肉类替代效应的研究所忽视的结构性饮食变迁。敏感性分析证实了结果的稳健性。理解近几十年来欧盟消费者饮食结构变迁的主要驱动力，对于未来研究高收入国家因环境和健康担忧导致红肉消费减少的课题具有关键意义。

title: Extreme justifications fuel polarisation
authors: Christiane Buschinger, Markus Eyting, Florian Hett, Judd Kessler
abstract: How does polarisation — as measured by mistreatment of political rivals — spread? In an online experiment, participants choose between splitting financial resources equally or discriminating against a supporter of the opposing political party. We vary the information subjects receive about others’ choices and justifications for discrimination. Exposure to extreme justifications for discrimination increases discrimination — particularly in a polarized environment, when many others are already discriminating — and it leads participants to adopt more extreme justifications themselves. Our findings suggest a self-reinforcing dynamic that may fuel polarisation: Exposure to extreme statements increases polarisation and the prevalence of extreme reasoning.
abstract_zh: 极化——以政治对手遭受不公对待为衡量标准——是如何扩散的？在一项在线实验中，参与者在平均分配财务资源与歧视对立政党支持者之间做出选择。我们调整了受试者接收到的关于他人选择及歧视理由的信息。接触极端的歧视理由会增加歧视行为——尤其是在极化环境中，当许多人已经实施歧视时——并且会导致参与者自身采用更极端的理由。我们的研究结果表明，一种可能加剧极化的自我强化动态：接触极端言论会加剧极化，并增加极端推理的普遍性。

title: Early-term abortion bans and sex selection after Dobbs v Jackson
title_zh: 多布斯诉杰克逊案后的早期堕胎禁令与性别选择
authors: Xin Brown, William Jergins
abstract: Following the 2022 US Supreme Court decision Dobbs v Jackson, many states adopted early-term abortion (ETA) bans that prohibit abortions before the age of viability and often before sex determination is technologically feasible. We analyze the effect of ETA bans on the sex ratio at birth among first-generation Chinese, Korean, and Indian (CKI) immigrants using difference-in-differences and triple differences methodologies. While our estimates across higher parity children sometimes indicate a decrease in the sex ratio at birth, they are also generally small and statistically insignificant, which is consistent with continued access to sex selection under ETA bans. In contrast, we find that ETA bans are associated with a large and statistically significant increase in the sex ratio at birth among first-parity children to immigrant CKI women. As elevated sex ratios have not been previously documented on first-parity children, this may indicate that ETA bans shift sex-selective behavior to earlier parities by placing additional emphasis on having a boy now, before any further restrictions on abortions occur. Our estimates suggest that ETA bans caused 139 missing, first-born girls in 2023 alone.
abstract_zh: 2022年美国最高法院对多布斯诉杰克逊案作出裁决后，许多州通过了早期堕胎禁令，禁止在胎儿存活期之前（且通常在技术无法确定胎儿性别之前）实施堕胎。我们采用双重差分法和三重差分法，分析了早期堕胎禁令对第一代华裔、韩裔和印度裔移民出生性别比的影响。尽管对较高胎次子女的估算有时显示出生性别比下降，但这些结果普遍较小且统计上不显著，这与早期堕胎禁令下仍可继续实施性别选择的情况一致。相反，我们发现早期堕胎禁令与移民华裔、韩裔和印度裔女性第一胎子女的出生性别比大幅且统计上显著上升相关。由于此前未发现第一胎子女存在性别比偏高现象，这可能表明早期堕胎禁令通过强调在进一步堕胎限制实施前优先生育男孩，将性别选择行为提前至更早胎次。我们的估算显示，仅2023年，早期堕胎禁令就导致139名第一胎女婴缺失。
